recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up source work is needed for FHIR-16730 unless the Vocabulary work group later reopens the broader question of how CodeSystem.hierarchyMeaning relates to external target-system hierarchies.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive with Modification STU3 Vocabulary issue requesting that CodeSystem.hierarchyMeaning clarify that it describes the hierarchy represented in the resource instance rather than any hierarchy in the target code system; the approved resolution rejected renaming the element to resourceHierarchyMeaning and required clarifying the definition.
initial_application: The issue was applied by git commit 392155e394348906aa2a48a3cfc8d421e764266b, imported from SVN revision 14722, with subject "GF#16730 - clarify definition". That commit changed source/codesystem/codesystem-spreadsheet.xml to use resource-scoped hierarchyMeaning wording and added a comment that other representations may have a different hierarchy or none. Later source conversion/refactor commits carried that wording into source/codesystem/structuredefinition-CodeSystem.xml and retained it.
additional_context: CodeSystem is an active current resource in source/fhir.ini. The current source definition says "The meaning of the hierarchy of concepts as represented in this resource" and the comment notes other representations may have a different hierarchy or none. Corrected Zulip and Confluence searches found no relevant discussion changing that conclusion. FHIR-25983 later touched hierarchyMeaning constraints and examples, but it is a separate already-reconciled issue and does not alter this definition.
reconciliation: No source edit was made because the current active CodeSystem StructureDefinition already implements the approved FHIR-16730 clarification without renaming the element.

related_jiras.note: Later hierarchyMeaning constraint work touched the same element family but is already represented on the combined branch and does not affect the FHIR-16730 definition decision.
